title: nan
authors: Lv M.; Wang Y.; Dong Y.; Hu J.; Xu Z.
key_contribution: Presents a multi-agent distributed UWB-based cooperative localization system analyzing non-stationary measurement noise, validated with a 5-UAV physical swarm prototype in partial GNSS-denied scenarios.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
